desc: Analyze the problem and derive the mathematical formula for the sum of path products.
Identify that the sum is a linear combination of grid values with constant coefficients based on binomial coefficients.
Plan the implementation: precompute factorials, compute initial sum, handle updates in $O(1)$.
Run the code against Sample 1 and Sample 2 to verify correctness.
Fix any bugs found (e.g., coordinate updates, 0-indexing vs 1-indexing).
